thread:
Anna: Morning — proposing per-tenant isolated canaries for Dedicated customers. Need quick decisions on traffic caps, isolation pool behavior, and console defaults.
Raj: +1. We should route canary traffic to tenant-scoped slices only; no cross-tenant KV cache sharing or spillover.
Sam: Implementation Q — ephemeral slices inside the dedicated pool vs. pinned per-tenant slice? Tradeoffs: isolation vs. warm KV cache.
Molly: Ops constraints: require isolation for any enterprise canary that touches customer data. Suggested guardrails: default max 3% traffic, auto-roll-back if p50 > 200ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m. Also require shadow runs for 24h before any >1% ramp.
Raj: Draft rollout config example:
```yaml
rollout:
  tenant_id: tenant_acme
  preset: enterprise-dedicated-safe-v1
  canary:
    traffic_percent: 2
    isolation_pool: tenant_acme_pool
    reserve_gpus: 1
    metrics:
      - name: p50_latency_ms
        threshold: 200
      - name: error_5xx_pct
        threshold: 0.5
    checks_window: 5m
    shadow_run_hours: 24
```
Raj: important: runtime must enforce isolation_pool binding so other tenants can't steal capacity.
Jess: For Console UX: slider for percentage + preset dropdown. Show cost delta and a required "reserve capacity" checkbox when isolation_pool is selected. Also add a small explainer: "Isolation tax = estimated additional infra cost".
Devex: I can prototype the preset + slider and show the cost tooltip. Propose preset names: enterprise-dedicated-safe-v1, enterprise-dedicated-fast-v1 (higher risk).
Canary-Bot: automatic capacity check: tenant_acme_pool headroom=10% (estimated safe canary up to 1.5% without reservations). Recommend reserve_gpus >= 1 to reach 2% safely.
Sam: API suggestion: POST /rollouts/create body: { tenant_id, preset, traffic_percent, isolation_required: true|false, reserve_gpus (int), run_mode: shadow|canary } — server returns rollout_id + estimated_cost/hour.
Molly: Telemetry notes: tag all canary metrics with tenant_id + slice_id. Alerts: create 'canary-regression' that fires to #eng-oncall and #customer-success if rollback triggers or if p50/error thresholds breached. Add an automated runbook link in alert.
Raj: Also we need a service-side throttle to enforce the 3% hard cap for non-reserved pools. Only override via admin-tier and recorded approval.
Anna: Agree. Action items: @Raj add API + server-side cap enforcement (ETA: Wed), @Devex prototype console mock (ETA: Fri), @Molly write alert rules and runbook (ETA: Fri EOD), @Sam add runtime enforcement for isolation binding and reserve_gpus behavior (ETA: Thurs).
Raj: Sounds good — I'll start a design doc. :thumbsup:
Jess: UX note — include a "preview rollout" that simulates latency/cost for 1h before applying.
Devex: will add preview mock.
Molly: quick ops ask — please include a flag to force immediate rollback and tenant blacklist if canary causes customer impact.
Anna: Agreed. We'll iterate on presets after we gather data from the first 3 tenants. Thanks everyone.
